verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a work-management SaaS could plausibly offer a UI extension framework for custom views or dashboard widgets. The evidence shows no such capability. The Views API (clickup-docs-33) only creates, filters, sorts and groups ClickUp's built-in view types, which is an adjacent configuration feature rather than building custom native-feeling views. The Figma embed and generic Public API are likewise adjacent integration features or developer building blocks. Nothing documents custom dashboard widgets or an embedded app/UI SDK.
